candidate_open_space_basis.retained_open_space: source green ∩ union(candidate green geometries + full-site potential-open-space parcels)
candidate_open_space_basis.free_space_retaining: source green ∩ (site_inner − building footprints − road corridor − sidewalks)
candidate_open_space_basis.note: the building layout is packed without the source greens as obstacles; every number is a post-hoc area intersection

status_thresholds.note: labels are descriptive reporting devices; no existing check reads them and no tolerance was widened

report.note: retained area is an area intersection; it does not establish spatial continuity, usability, access, planting or design intent for the original green. The source greens are not treated as obstacles by the building layout, so occupation was measured after the fact, not prevented.
